ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all General Partner directors, limited partners, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against UN Consolidated Sanctions List, HM Treasury Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, and Bermuda's Domestic Sanctions List maintained by the Advisory Panel on Economic Sanctions. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs), family members, and close associates, including independent verification of source of wealth. All screening must be evidenced in a written compliance file retained for at least five years, with immediate onward reporting to the Bermuda Financial Intelligence Agency of any positive match or suspicious activity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies official online name search and reservation portal (e-Registry, accessible via www.roc.gov.bm)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be submitted in English using the Latin alphabet. If a foreign script is presented, it must be transliterated into English using standard romanisation; the statutory name appearing on the register must be the English romanised version. Names must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and must end with 'Limited Partnership', 'L.P.', or 'LP' as appropriate for an Exempted Limited Partnership.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may request written reasons from the Registrar, amend the proposed name and resubmit, or file a formal appeal to the Minister of Finance under the Companies Act 1981 / Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 within 30 days of the rejection notice. An appeal must be accompanied by a statutory declaration and the prescribed fee; the Minister's decision is subject to judicial review by the Supreme Court of Bermuda.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as a first-step registration address where a licensed Bermuda registered agent provides a physical street address and maintains statutory registers. However, for a marine fuel bunkering and replenishment operation under Bermuda law, the partnership must demonstrate adequate commercial substance in Bermuda, including a physical office, qualified local management, and operational decision-making presence, to satisfy the Economic Substance Act 2018 requirements. A pure virtual office with no local operating substance will not meet the licensing or substance standard.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high risk, estimated at 40-55% within the first 12 months of operation, given the enhanced AML risk tier assigned to ship bunkering and the Bermuda Registrar of Companies / Bermuda Economic Substance Authority's active inspection regime; unannounced physical inspections are more likely where the registered office is a virtual address or where the partnership's activities are perceived as mobile or high-risk.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Partnerships Act 2016, ss. 4(1), 5(1), 7(2); Partnership Act 1902 (supplementary); Companies Act 1981 (residual application for corporate general partners)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form ELP-1 Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; capital is contractually fixed in the Limited Partnership Deed. No escrow account is required at formation; subscribed capital may be payable on call.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The formation of the Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) is approved. (2) The initial capital subscriptions of the Limited Partners are accepted in accordance with the Partnership Agreement. (3) The registered office is adopted at the address of the appointed registered office service provider in Bermuda. (4) The General Partner is authorized to execute the Partnership Agreement and to appoint officers, custodians and bank signatories. (5) The officers are directed to file the Exempted Partnerships Act 2016 registration documents with the Registrar of Companies and to obtain all commercial and bunkering licences. (6) All actions taken by the General Partner prior to this meeting are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability check and beneficial-owner due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (online company registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct an electronic name search in the Register of Companies to confirm no identical or misleadingly similar name. Submit the name clearance request via the e-Registry or through an approved corporate service provider. Retain the name availability reference for 90 days. Verify that the proposed general partner is qualified under section 4 of the Exempted Partnerships Act 2016 and complete beneficial-owner identification.
required_dossiers: Certificate of good standing of general partner (if corporate)
Beneficial owner identity verification pack (passport, utility bill, source of funds declaration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may re-apply with a distinct name or request a written decision and appeal to the Supreme Court under the Companies (Appeals) Rules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Limited Partnership Deed and registered-office appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved Registered Corporate Service Provider / General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The General Partner executes the Limited Partnership Deed and the list of Limited Partners' subscriptions. Obtain written consent from the registered office provider in Bermuda. The registered office must be a physical street address. The deed need not be notarized but must be dated and witnessed; retain original signatures for registry inspection.
required_dossiers: Consent of the registered office provider
Subscription schedule and capital commitment schedules
Certificate of Incumbency of the General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar identifies a defect in the deed or consent, the documents may be re-executed by way of a rectification deed and re-filed within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the registration application under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2016
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government Administration Building, 30 Parliament Street, Hamilton HM 12
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and file Form ELP-1 Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership together with certified copies of the partnership deed, registered-office consent and declarations. Pay the government filing fee at the Registry cashier or by wire through the e-Registry. Original documents are retained by the registered office service provider; certified copies are electronically submitted.
required_dossiers: AML/KYC declarations from the General Partner and Limited Partners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Registrar will issue a requisition letter identifying the defect. The filing party must respond with a curative letter and amended documents within 21 days. If the requisition is not satisfied, the application lapses but may be reinstated on fresh filing with payment of a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of government fees and collection of the Certificate of Formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies — Exempted Partnerships Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Settle the official incorporation fee (US$2,180 or BMD equivalent) and any courier disbursement. After approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Exempted Limited Partnership and publishes the formation. Retrieve the certificate in electronic format from the e-Registry and check that the legal name, registration number, classification and registered office are correctly stated.
required_dossiers: Approved Form ELP-1 with registrar stamp
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, submit a certified correction form and return the original certificate to the Registry for cancellation and reissue within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation organizational resolutions and ancillary licensing preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Partner and Bermuda Shipping and Maritime Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first meeting of the General Partner to adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, approve bank account signatories and confirm the authorized dealer and domicile. Thereafter prepare the marine bunkering licence application, environmental assessment documentation and fire-safety clearance to satisfy stage-2 industrial and physical licensing obligations.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the General Partner's first meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the maritime authority raises technical objections, amend the operations manual and re-submit the licence application. If bank onboarding is challenged, present the Certificate of Formation and partnership deed to the compliance officer or select an alternate licensed bank.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Bermuda Environmental Protection Agency — Department of Environment and Natural Resources
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category A – Full EIA Report where fixed or shore-based bunkering is proposed; Category B – Environmental Screening Registration and Pollution Prevention Plan for vessel-to-vessel bunkering
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater oily content <15 ppm before any discharge and no discharge in coastal waters; fuel sulphur content meeting MARPOL Annex VI 0.50% m/m global cap; VOC abatement at transfer points; all waste oils handled by licensed waste processors; spill response plan meeting the Marine Oil Pollution (Preparedness, Response and Co-operation) Act 2005

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service fire certification, structural certification for piers and fuel storage, Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) workplace clearance, and Civil Defence oil spill emergency plan approval.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC), Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda — filing portal 'Bermuda Tax Online' at https://www.gov.bm/corporate-income-tax; Registrar of Companies (Bermuda Registry) at https://www.bermudaregistry.bm for entity incorporation under the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015; Bermuda Customs and Revenue Agency (BCRA) for customs duty registration and the Bermuda Customs Electronic Single-Window declaration platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: File the Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) registration application with the Registrar of Companies under the Exempted Limited Partnership Act 2015; upon approval, the Bermuda Registry issues a Certificate of Registration and an entity registration number (the statutory corporate identifier). Step 2: If the ELP forms part of an in-scope Multinational Enterprise (MNE) group with consolidated global revenue of at least EUR 750 million, or if it expects to derive Bermuda-attributable profits within the scope of the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, register for Bermuda Corporate Income Tax (CIT) with the OTC through Bermuda Tax Online and obtain a CIT Tax Identification Number (TIN). Step 3: If the ELP employs Bermuda-resident staff, register as an employer under the Payroll Tax Act 1995 and obtain a Payroll Tax Account Number via Bermuda Tax Online. Step 4: For import/export of bunker fuel and lubricants, procure an Importer/Exporter Customs Code from the BCRA and establish a bonded warehouse or storage licence application file where duty-suspension is sought. Step 5: Obtain the Bermuda Economic Substance filing reference if the ELP conducts relevant insurance, finance, or shipping activities in Bermuda. The same ELP may lawfully hold separate identifiers (CIT TIN, Payroll Account, Customs Code, Substance Reference) for distinct statutory purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible; Territorial_Scope; Tax_Exempt_Zone (Bermuda historically levies no corporate income, capital gains, or withholding taxes on foreign-source income; the ELP is presumptively transparent for tax purposes. Effective 1 January 2025, the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 imposes a 15% CIT on profits attributable to Bermuda for in-scope MNE groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million, subject to transitional relief, economic substance adjustments, and QDMTT mechanics; ordinary foreign-source bunkering income remains outside the Bermuda tax net for non-in-scope groups).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Partnership Classification Election: Under draft OTC guidance implementing the CIT Act 2023, an ELP may elect transparent (default, CIT at partner level) or non-transparent (entity-level CIT) treatment; transparency is mandatory unless an election is approved to prevent mismatch. Hybrid Mismatch Alignment: An ELP may file an election with the OTC to conform Bermuda classification to the U.S. check-the-box or the UK/Cayman classification of the partnership so as to neutralise BEPS Action 2 hybrid mismatch outcomes. QDMTT Safe Harbour Election: In-scope MNE groups may elect the Bermuda qualified domestic minimum top-up tax regime as the jurisdictional top-up mechanism under Pillar Two GloBE rules. Transitional Substance Election: An ELP may elect to apply the substance-based carve-out and economic substance rules for CIT attribution. No general check-the-box regime analogous to the U.S. exists; elections are made in writing to the OTC within the first CIT filing period, with binding effect for 5 fiscal years.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or Sales and Use Tax in Bermuda (UK VAT at 20% does not apply; Bermuda is a separate customs and tax territory outside the UK VAT area). Bermuda relies on employer-level Payroll Tax, Stamp Duty, and Customs Duty (importation tariff): tariffs on imported fuels and goods range from 0% to 33.25% ad valorem depending on the Customs Tariff classification; bunker fuel entered into the customs area for domestic use is dutiable, whereas duty-suspension and foreign-going vessel relief apply to international bunker supply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: N/A for VAT/GST (no such tax exists). For CIT registration: in-scope MNE group global consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million (approximately BMD 750 million), with CIT applying to Bermuda-attributable profits. For Payroll Tax registration: any employer (including an ELP) with Bermuda-resident employees, subject to the annual exempt allowance per employee under the Payroll Tax Act 1995. For Customs Duty: no turnover threshold; registration requires an Importer/Exporter Customs Code and, for duty-suspended bunkering, a Bonded Warehouse or Freeport licence.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic fiscal clearance, Continuous Transaction Control (CTC), or digital stamping regime applies in Bermuda for commercial invoices or Bunker Delivery Notes. Customs declarations must be lodged electronically through the Bermuda Customs single-window / electronic customs declaration system, supporting automated risk profiling and digital release of excisable and bonded goods. CIT returns and payroll tax filings are made electronically through Bermuda Tax Online, and supporting transfer pricing documents must be retained in electronic or physical form for at least 7 years. Bunker Delivery Note requirements under MARPOL Annex VI (including digital or paper copies retained for 3 years) are observed as a maritime compliance matter, not a tax clearance mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT zero-rating is inapplicable because Bermuda has no VAT. Customs duty relief applies to goods entered for export or re-export under section 21 of the Customs Act 1963, provided customs control is maintained and export occurs within the statutory period (generally 12 months; 30 days for transshipment). Bunker fuel and lubricants delivered to ships engaged in foreign-going international trade are eligible for duty-free supply when withdrawn from a bonded warehouse, from a duty-suspended storage facility, or through the Bermuda Freeport Zone, provided the product is not consumed within the customs area, the vessel qualifies as foreign-going, and a valid Bunker Delivery Note and export/re-export declaration evidence the international voyage. No VAT refund mechanism exists because no indirect tax was charged; the substantive benefit is duty relief at import/supply, which requires complete documentary substantiation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bermuda Customs Export Declaration / Re-Export Entry (electronic declaration filed via the Bermuda Customs single-window system)
Bill of Lading (through-negotiable ocean bill evidencing carriage from a Bermuda port or bonded storage to a foreign port)
Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) issued in accordance with MARPOL Annex VI regulation 18, stating the vessel, IMO number, port, product grade, quantity, and delivery date

Inward/Outward Foreign Currency Remittance Certificate issued by a Bermuda-licensed bank or the ELP's external account bank, evidencing repatriation of export/bunker sale proceeds into the ELP's account
Charter Party or International Sale and Purchase Contract (including the bunker supply agreement) demonstrating that the supply serves a foreign-going vessel
Certificate of Foreign-Going Status / Vessel Clearance Certificate issued by the Bermuda Maritime Administration or port authority confirming departure to a foreign destination
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda Customs may re-assess duty on exported or duty-free bunker fuel if the documentation bundle is incomplete, if the vessel is not foreign-going, if the fuel is diverted into the domestic market, or if export does not occur within the statutory period; penalties include recovery of the full unpaid duty plus a penalty of up to 50% of the duty (strict liability) and, in cases of fraud or misdeclaration, forfeiture of goods, a penalty of up to three times the duty value, and fines up to BMD 5,000 per offence. Under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023, fraudulent failure to register, failure to file, concealment, or false CIT declarations attract a penalty of 20% of under-assessed CIT plus interest at the statutory rate (Treasury bill yield plus 5%), and criminal prosecution on indictment. The OTC may apply the General Anti-Abuse Rule to disregard artificial arrangements producing a tax benefit, extend the assessment period to 6 years (unlimited in the case of fraud), and retrospectively claw back CIT, QDMTT, or duty relief with interest compounded from the original due date.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), operating under the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969 and the Exchange Control Act 1972; the BMA acts as exchange-control administrator and prudential supervisor of all Bermuda-licensed banks and authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian Dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US Dollar. Current-account transactions are fully convertible for both residents and non-residents, and a non-resident-designated Bermuda Exempted Partnership may hold, credit, and disburse USD freely without BMA application. Capital-account flows (capital contributions, distributions, and liquidation proceeds) are liberalized for non-resident-controlled ELPs, subject only to source-of-funds documentation; there is no materiality threshold or BMA prior-approval requirement. Profit remittance to the UK parent is unrestricted once audited financial statements and a distribution resolution are in place.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act 1972 and BMA Exchange Control Notices, resident persons must offer foreign-currency proceeds to an authorized dealer within 30 days of receipt, or obtain an open-currency-account exemption. A Bermuda-domiciled ELP that is formally designated 'non-resident' (with a non-resident BMD account in the ELP's name through its resident representative) is exempt from statutory surrender; bunkering revenue received in USD may therefore be retained offshore indefinitely. The ELP should maintain a current non-resident designation letter from the BMA or its resident agent to evidence this exemption.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Settlement Account with Standby LC facility

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Finance (MT700/MT760) USD Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW-MEDIUM (supplementary rail only). UK FCA-regulated e-money institutions cannot operate local Bermuda accounts or clear BMD, and the BMA's Financial Institutions Act 1998 reserves deposit-taking and payment services to licensed persons; an overseas EMI may therefore process GBP/EUR supplier payments on an outsourced basis but can never serve as the ELP's primary treasury anchor, capital escrow location, or AML/KYC hub. Any EMI usage must be ring-fenced below 10% of monthly settlement volume and supported by a supplemental due-diligence file on the EMI's UK license status.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory physical-appearance requirement; remote onboarding is accepted by all four Tier-1 banks using notarized and apostilled corporate documentation, certified passport copies, a board resolution of the General Partner, and a live video KYC interview with the bank's MLRO. Physical presence is required only if a committed credit facility or Standby LC in excess of USD 5 million is requested, in which case the authorized signatory may be required to attend a Bermuda meeting or use an approved Bermuda law-firm attestation. Video interviews are mandatory for all signatories, including the UK-based General Partner of the ELP.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through partnership opacity: the ELP's beneficial owners sit behind multiple intermediate holding layers, triggering the bank's enhanced due diligence and look-through obligations under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Limited Partnership; registered agent and resident representative letter; complete LP Agreement; BO Act 2017 register extract; corporate structure chart disclosing all natural persons with >25% interest or control; UK parent's confirmation statement; notarized ID and source-of-wealth forms for each ultimate principal.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bunkering-sector trade-based money-laundering red flags: multi-jurisdiction invoicing, third-party payments to vessel owners and suppliers, and commingled cargo payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed bunker supply contracts and stem orders; ISO 8217 and ASTM D2069 product certificates; invoice-to-payment mapping against named counterparty accounts; bill of lading and barge-delivery receipts; vessel IMO registration and sanctions screen; IBIA membership evidence; internal trade-flow verification procedure manual; sanctions and AML training records for the finance team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction nexus: procurement or delivery counterparties touching embargoed or high-FATF-risk countries (e.g., Iran, North Korea, Syria, or grey-listed jurisdictions), a material concern for marine fuel traders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions compliance manual referencing the UK Sanctions List, OFAC SDN, EU consolidated list, and Bermuda consolidated sanctions list; contractual origin-of-cargo attestations from every supplier; refusal-to-deal log; country-risk and FATF risk-matrix; vessel voyage validation against prohibited-port lists; MLRO sign-off on each stem involving high-risk counterparties; ship-supplier vetting reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Liquidity mismatch: large USD inflows from bunkering resales materially exceeding the ELP's disclosed capital base and expected stem size, or back-to-back transfers without underlying trade evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital-account schedule and partners' funding confirmations; audited or reviewed financial statements; 12-month trade-flow forecast and monthly stem reconciliation; stock and delivery-receipt evidence for resale book; paired MT103 confirmations for each cargo; letter from a Bermuda law firm confirming the ELP's non-resident status and legitimate partnership purposes; commercial rationale memo for any intra-group loan.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions from the UK parent or partners are effected by SWIFT MT103 to the ELP's USD account at HSBC or Butterfield, quoting the ELP's registration number, the payment purpose 'Investment - Capital Contribution to Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership', and the UK sender's purpose code 'Investment in overseas associated undertaking'. A signed capital-call notice, a constituent-partner resolution, a source-of-wealth form, and a copy of the ELP's non-resident designation must accompany the transfer to prevent return or rejection. For funds above USD 1 million, pre-notification to the receiving compliance team through a local relationship manager is advisable. No BMA exchange-control approval applies because the ELP is non-resident; any USD/BMD conversion is executed at the fixed 1:1 peg with no FX cost.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Core rails for bunkering settlements: (1) SWIFT MT103 for prompt payment of stems, terminal fees, and port dues to verified supplier accounts; (2) SWIFT MT700 documentary Letter of Credit for bulk VLSFO and HSFO purchases from refiners, with presentation documents comprising commercial invoice, ISO 8217 quality certificate, bill of lading, delivery receipt, and weighing or handling certificates; (3) SWIFT MT760 Standby LC issued by a Bermuda bank in favor of credit suppliers to unlock open-account terms; and (4) USD, GBP, and EUR treasury sweep sub-accounts that net intercompany flows between the ELP and the UK parent. Every disbursement requires dual authorization (General Partner plus finance officer), a cleared sanctions screen of the payee, and a match against the underlying stem and invoice for traceability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward outrights (up to 12 months) in EUR/USD and GBP/USD with BMA-licensed dealing banks to lock margins on ARA-region and UK-port bunker procurement
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD) to hedge multi-quarter terminal supply agreements, subject to board authorization under the LP Agreement

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for ancillary non-convertible currencies (e.g., NGN, IDR, KES) when sourcing from West African or Southeast Asian ports, permitted only with BMA-authorized dealers and with no underlying exposure beyond the invoiced stem
BMD/USD spot conversion at the 1:1 official peg, documented as a notional accounting hedge between BMD and USD ledgers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration of the Exempted Limited Partnership (Exempted Partnerships Act 2017, section 42)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days after each anniversary of the ELP registration date; anniversary-based cycle with no fixed calendar date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues a fees-regulation surcharge and blocks the annual certificate of compliance; prolonged non-payment triggers a Registrar default notice, suspension of exempted status, and administrative strike-off; reinstatement requires court application and settlement of arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Return under the Economic Substance Act 2018, as extended to Exempted Partnerships
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies, Economic Substance Department (ESR Connect portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the financial year-end, e.g., by 30 June for a 31 December year-end; a non-resident exclusion with HMRC UK tax residence certificate must be claimed annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 1,000 per day of continuing default; non-compliance exposes the ELP to OECD/EU information exchange with HMRC and, for sustained failure, deregistration by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Return and annual re-confirmation (Beneficial Ownership Transparency Act 2020)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Corporate Affairs), Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial BO return within 30 days of ELP registration; annual re-confirmation aligned to the Annual Declaration anniversary; any ownership change or limited partner substitution reported within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Summary conviction fines up to BMD 25,000 plus BMD 1,000 daily default fines; restriction notices may bar transfer of partnership interests; the Registrar may strike off the ELP for continued non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is imposed on an ELP under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2017; an independent audit becomes compulsory only where (i) the ELP is a Bermuda Monetary Authority-regulated collective investment scheme or investment fund, (ii) audited financial statements are required as a bank covenant for bunkering trade finance, supply contracts, or standby letter of credit facilities, or (iii) the UK General Partner's group reporting rules require audit inclusion.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda prescribes no domestic GAAP for ELPs; accounts are prepared under IFRS as the default framework, with UK GAAP acceptable where UK statutory or lender requirements apply; marine fuel inventory and vessel-related leases are recognized under IFRS 15, IFRS 16 and IAS 2 where audited.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under BOTA 2020 and the EPA 2017, the General Partner must file beneficial ownership particulars with the Registrar within 30 days of formation, keep the on-site BO register current, and re-confirm BO details together with each Annual Declaration at the registration anniversary; any transfer or substitution of a limited partner interest must be recorded in the Register of Partners, the Register of Contributions, and the BO register within 30 days, and the partner transfer is effective against third parties only after such recording.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of General and Limited Partners
Minute Book of Partner Resolutions and Consents

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $4,500 - $8,500 per annum for a licensed Bermuda corporate services provider covering registered office, corporate secretarial services, and regulatory correspondence
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $15,000 - $35,000 per annum for a full IFRS audit by a Bermuda certified public accountant, incurred only if a bank covenant, trade finance facility, or BMA regulation requires audited accounts

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% standard Bermuda exempted undertaking income tax; 15% Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 top-up rate for in-scope multinational groups with consolidated revenue of EUR 750 million or more
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Exempted Limited Partnership status provides pass-through tax classification; no entity-level corporate income tax on partnership profits; no capital gains tax; no gross-receipts tax on non-resident partners' offshore income; statutory payroll tax and social insurance contributions may apply only if the ELP has Bermuda employees. For CIT Act in-scope groups, the effective top-up tax rate is reduced by creditable foreign taxes and qualified substance-based income exclusion, yielding a minimum effective burden of 15% on GloBE profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return (prescribed CIT-1 form) submitted through the Bermuda Tax Administration e-Filing portal. Exempted Limited Partnerships outside CIT Act scope are not required to file an income tax return; they file an annual declaration with the Registrar of Companies via the Bermuda eRegistry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: CIT return due within 15 months after the fiscal year-end; first CIT filing period may be extended to 18 months. The annual exempted partnership declaration is due by 31 January following the partnership's fiscal year-end unless an extension is granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification, registration number, exempted partnership name, registered office in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners are identified on the partnership schedule; no separate CIT return is required unless the partnership is itself an in-scope constituent entity under the CIT Act. Provide CRO registration certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Pass-through and partnership structure declaration, including number of general and limited partners and their tax residence status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter each non-resident partner's jurisdiction of tax residence. No Bermuda tax withholding is triggered on allocations to non-resident partners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: MNE group status and GloBE revenue threshold determination.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the partnership is part of a group with consolidated revenue below EUR 750 million, mark not in scope. If in scope, attach group structure documentation and parent jurisdiction notices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda-source income, economic nexus, and relevant activity classification under the Economic Substance (Partnerships) Act 2018.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe whether ship bunkering and refueling is conducted outside Bermuda. Non-resident partners should maintain supporting invoices and bills of lading to evidence offshore core income-generating activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of taxable profit or loss to partners in accordance with the partnership deed and pass-through eligibility.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate profits to non-resident partners according to their percentage interests. No entity-level tax is imposed on allocations; each partner reports income under its own tax residence rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of chargeable income or allowable loss, including any deductions, tax credits, and substance-based income exclusion.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident partners, attach a computation showing no Bermuda-source income unless the partnership maintains a Bermuda office or employees. Claim itemized deductions only where contractually borne by the partnership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits and DTA relief application.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners claiming relief in their home jurisdiction must append a Bermuda Tax Authority certificate of residence. Bermuda itself imposes no withholding or corporate income tax to relieve.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signatory confirmation of accuracy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The general partner or authorised representative signs; non-resident limited partners are not required to sign unless they act as manager or control the ELP.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late CIT return filing for an in-scope group attracts an initial penalty of BMD 500 and a daily surcharge of BMD 50 up to a maximum of BMD 10,000; underpaid CIT accrues interest at 10% per annum and a 10% surcharge on the shortfall. Failure to file the annual exempted partnership declaration may result in late filing fees, automatic dissolution of the ELP after 90 days of non-compliance, and disqualification of the general partner for subsequent registration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda imposes no dividend, interest, royalty, or branch-remittance withholding tax, so no Bermuda filing is required to obtain relief. Where a non-resident partner claims treaty benefits in its own jurisdiction, the Bermuda Tax Authority issues a certificate of tax residence upon written application, usually within 10 business days; a certified copy is submitted to the foreign tax authority together with the relevant treaty claim form. For UK-Bermuda DTA relief, HMRC requires the TRC in support of UK foreign tax credit or treaty exemption claims.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on outbound royalties and interest. Treaty rates: effectively 0% under the Bermuda-United Kingdom DTA because domestic law imposes no withholding; for other jurisdictions, no Bermuda treaty relief is available, but the 0% domestic rate prevents any Bermuda source tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BMD 750,000,000 (equivalent to EUR 750,000,000) consolidated group revenue triggers optional or mandatory transfer pricing documentation only for CIT Act in-scope multinational groups. Exempted partnerships outside CIT scope have no statutory Local File or Master File requirement under Bermuda income tax law.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance (Partnerships) Act 2018 applies to exempted partnerships conducting relevant activities, which may include shipping, support services, or distribution and service centres. A ship bunkering and refueling ELP must demonstrate compliance if it derives income from activities connected to Bermuda or claims tax residence outside Bermuda; core income-generating activities must be performed with adequate physical presence, full-time employees, and management in Bermuda, unless the partnership is tax resident in a qualifying jurisdiction with no Bermuda substance obligation. Annual ESR filing is administered by the Bermuda Registrar of Companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting allocated partnership profits from a CIT Act filing, filing false CIT returns, or fabricating loss and expense records to reduce the 15% top-up tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Financial penalty up to 200% of the understated tax, statutory interest at 10% per annum, daily default penalties, and criminal fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors or general partners who knowingly cause false returns face personal civil restitution, disqualification from acting as a director in Bermuda, travel bans, and imprisonment for up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the ELP as a shell with no office, no employees, and no documented decision-making in Bermuda while claiming exemption from CIT and ESR relevant activity requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory winding up or strike-off of the exempted partnership; civil penalty of BMD 100,000; revocation of exempted status; denial of tax residence certificates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: General partners and directors may be jointly and severally liable for unpaid penalties, banned from obtaining new Bermuda licenses or registrations for up to 5 years, and subject to director disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using SWIFT wire or standby letters of credit to settle bunker sales on behalf of sanctioned vessels, failing to perform beneficial ownership due diligence, or concealing the identity of the ultimate shipowner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the Bermuda Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 and Sanctions Act may reach BMD 1,000,000 per breach, asset forfeiture, suspension of the ELP registration, and revocation of any required fuel supply license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers knowingly engaged in laundering or sanctions breaches face imprisonment up to 14 years, seizure of personal assets, travel bans, and civil claims by creditors under piercing-of-the-veil doctrines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misapplying the arm's length standard in a CIT Act in-scope group by charging artificially low bunker supply margins to a related ship operator or shifting profits to a no-tax parent with no substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax adjustment to the 15% CIT base, underpayment interest at 10% per annum, and penalty of 50% of the resulting tax shortfall if intent to avoid tax is shown.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve non-arm's length pricing documentation are personally liable for the penalty portion if they knew of the deviation; they may be disqualified and, in egregious cases, criminally prosecuted for false accounting.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Supplying false information on the annual exempted partnership declaration, forging a certificate of tax residence, or misrepresenting the non-resident ownership structure to avoid CIT obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate suspension of the declaration filing; administrative penalty of BMD 50,000 for each false statement; cancellation of exempted status; order for restoration of all unpaid taxes and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual signatories face perjury charges, imprisonment up to 5 years, civil liability to the Registrar and tax authority for losses caused, and a permanent bar on representing any Bermuda entity.
